name: The Depths — Episode 5: The Debris Field

entree.title: The Edge
entree.narrator: Between two wrecks, the water no longer flows — it hesitates.
entree.text:
You enter the field — episode 4 behind you, the clattering **ahead**.

Your HUD:

**290 m remaining · depth 520 m · lamp 12% · heading 214°**

Capsized hulls. Containers stacked like thrown dice. A crane without a cab, arm buried in silt.

The metallic noise resumes — **closer**. Something **shifts** the wrecks. Slowly. Like a body searching for a corridor too narrow.

The orange glow pulses between two cargo ships — heading still true.

choices.text: Charge between the cargo ships — shortcut
Go over the wrecks — longer, safer

couloir.title: Wreck Corridor
couloir.narrator: A corridor underwater has no walls — only what hasn't moved yet.
couloir.text:
You advance through a choke point — containers on both sides, one metre thirty of passage.

At **560 m**, the clattering **stops**.

Silence.

Then a long, sharp grind — **above** you. A container slides five centimetres. Not fallen. **Adjusted.**

Your lamp: **11%**.

Two exits visible:

**A — Pass under the crane** (low corridor, 80 cm)
**B — Fracture in a hull** (inside a wreck · dark)

audace_grue.title: Under the Crane
audace_grue.narrator: When metal moves above you, speed becomes a prayer.
audace_grue.text:
You slip under the crane arm.

Tight space. Your suit catches a rusted plate. You pull free.

The lamp sweeps murky water — and **catches** something.

Not a wreck.

A **band** of pale, smooth skin crossing the wreck corridor at your level — then vanishing between two containers **without pushing them aside**. As if the metal had opened.

The clattering resumes — **behind** you now.

Battery: **10%**.

choices.text: 🔦 Keep the light on — sprint for the exit of the choke point

audace_fuite.title: Wreck Sprint
audace_fuite.narrator: Running underwater means accepting that fear carries you faster than your fins.
audace_fuite.text:
You charge.

Containers. Sheet metal. A crane hook missing your helmet by a centimetre.

Behind — the clattering **speeds up**. Not a current. A **pursuer**.

You emerge from the choke point at **610 m**. Open space — relatively.

Your lamp flickers: **9%**.

The radio, one syllable:

*« —…don't look back… — »*

choices.text: Keep toward the glow — don't turn around

lucidite_coque.title: Inside the Wreck
lucidite_coque.narrator: The inside of a dead ship keeps the memory of its corridors — even without light.
lucidite_coque.text:
You enter through the fracture.

Sloped corridor. Floating crates. Dead panels.

You **switch off** the lamp — reflex learned at relay N-7.

In the black: the clattering is **muffled**. Distant. Outside.

You move by hand — left wall, mental counter. Three right turns. Descent. Fifth door open.

When you switch on again: **11%** — you didn't run.

Exit through a breach in the hull — **610 m**, out of the dense field.

lucidite_sombre.title: Blind
lucidite_sombre.narrator: Without a beam, you learn that fear has geometry too.
lucidite_sombre.text:
Total black.

Hand on the left container. No **immediate** clattering. The pursuer searches elsewhere — or waits.

You count fin strokes. Twenty. Forty.

A cold current — vertical. Natural **descent**. You follow it.

When you finally switch on: **10%**. Choke point clear. **595 m**.

Nothing touched you. You **think**.

passage.title: Field Exit
passage.narrator: When the wrecks thin out, what lies ahead is no longer metal — it's architecture.
passage.text:
The containers spread apart.

The clattering fades — or stops. You can't tell anymore.

Your HUD:

**165 m remaining · depth 640 m · heading 214°**

Your lamp: **8%**.

Ahead, the orange glow finally reveals part of its source — not the portal. A **black stone arch**, immense, carved with Fableris runes and pumpkin motifs.

An underwater **cathedral**. Gaping entrance. Black.

The radio murmurs:

*« —{{player}}… final stretch… the lamp won't last until the portal… — »*

choices.text: Descend toward the arch — one last push

fin_debris.title: The Black Arch
fin_debris.narrator: Some doors underwater don't wait to be opened — they wait for you to dare enter.
fin_debris.text:
You reach the threshold at **670 m**.

The debris field stretches **behind** you — kilometres of scrap, silence restored.

Ahead: the arch. Beyond: flooded nave, columns rising into the black, distant altar where the **true** glow pulses — warmer than the relays. Closer to the portal.

**140 m remaining.**

Your lamp: **7%**. One last pulse — then steady. For how long?

**END EPISODE 5 — The Debris Field**

*Episode 6: The Cathedral — coming soon*
